game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Ore Smelter, a smelter processing glowing ore: the lava scout must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Exponent Engine: Use ** to power up engines: level 3 should deliver 2**3 energy.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ore Smelter: a smelter processing glowing ore
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Read n. Display Above when n > 1; otherwise display At or below. Test dataset 6: {'n': -1}; {'n': 4}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Exponent Engine' (Week 2 slot 11), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Ore Smelter'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Reach the fire shrine using at most 12 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The fire shrine reached with actions_used <= 12.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 12 before the fire shrine is reached, or lives reach 0.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
